Alyssa (Partnerships): Heads up — we need to lock SI referral attribution caps for Q3. Quick sync? @Raj @Marco :eyes:
Raj (Sales): +1. My thought: a default 20% referral credit for SI-sourced leads, tapered by deal size. Thoughts?
Marco (SI Partner): That seems fine for T-shirt deals. For enterprise (> $250k) we usually want 10-12% or flat referral fee. Also need clarity on attribution window.
Susan (RevOps): Attribution window proposal: 30 days from lead creation for direct claims, 90 days for influenced deals. If SI is the initial lead source -> primary attribution. Here’s a sample export mapping we use:
```
si_id,company_domain,lead_source,claimed_by,claim_ts,deal_total
SI-4433,acme.com,partner_referral,Marco,2025-07-14,120000
SI-9911,betaco.com,marketplace_lead,,
```
Alyssa (Partnerships): Susan — can we add a 'referral_cap' column? Need to enforce 1 cap per quarter per SI account for credits.
Susan (RevOps): Yep — suggestion: referral_cap as USD or percentage string. I'll run a quick script to backfill historical claims and repro the economics. :gear: 
Raj (Sales): Also need rules for jointly-sourced deals (SI + Redwood sales). Propose split attribution by first touch = 70/30 (SI/Sales) unless SI is exclusive owner.
Marco (SI Partner): 70/30 is acceptable if there's a signed co-sell MOU. Otherwise SI wants higher.
Alyssa (Partnerships): Action items:
- Susan to add referral_cap column and run backfill (ETA EOD Tue)
- Raj to draft co-sell MOU language for split rules (ETA Fri)
- Marco to send list of priority accounts to lock-in caps (ETA Wed)

Susan (RevOps): I'll attach the CSV to the partner portal and add validation rules (no duplicate claims, one active cap per SI id). Will flag any overlaps.
Partner Bot: Automatch job scheduled: run/referral-recon at 2025-08-01T04:00Z :robot_face:
Raj (Sales): If the automatch finds overlaps, notify Alyssa and #raj-sales-channel.
Alyssa (Partnerships): Great. Let’s reconvene next Wednesday 10am PT. I'll create the calendar invite. :calendar:
Marco (SI Partner): Thanks — sending priority account list now. :thumbsup:
Raj (Sales): ack
Susan (RevOps): ack
Alyssa (Partnerships): closing loop — rolling to execution. :white_check_mark:
